explain.en: Your JianyingPro drafts. This is your work: Hoardless only shows the size so you know where the space went.
explain.zh: 你的剪映草稿，是你的作品。这里只显示大小，让你知道空间用在哪。

evidence.note: JianyingPro 11.5.0 on the maintainer's Mac: 26G; globalSetting currentCustomDraftPath points here. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Drafts can be moved in the app (currentCustomDraftPath); needs a resolver.
